caseName: Shearson Lehman/American Express Inc. v. Bird
caseNameFull: Shearson Lehman/American Express Inc. v. Bird, Individually and as Trustee of the Frank L. Bird Profit Sharing Trust

opinions.text:
C. A. 2d Cir. Motion *885of Securities Industry Association et al. for leave to file a brief as amici curiae granted. Certiorari granted, judgment vacated, and case remanded for further consideration in light of Rodriguez de Quijas v. Shear son/American Express, Inc., 490 U. S. 477 (1989).

Justice Brennan, Justice Marshall, and Justice Stevens dissent.
